_README: Where the site's navigation points, in one place. Edit, then run:
which rewrites the header, footer and head of every page in site/ and the
fails if any page has drifted from these values.
'/portfolio/' are the pages in this repository. When simulations.idlery.com
or portfolio.idlery.com is live, set the value to its full https:// URL.
The navigation then links straight there, and build.py adds a forced 301
from the old path so every existing link follows.
